name: Ishikawa Goemon
source:
A notorious thief in the capital of Kyo. He steals from the rich to give to the poor and is popular among the townspeople.
During the day he uses the persona of "Gorou the Libertine".
Since the Council of the Five Elders is to be held in Kyo, Minister Ishida Mitsunari is desperate to catch him.
